announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders receive the outcome of the Annual General Meeting. This follows the October final results announcement.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of final annual results, which provides shareholders with a comprehensive review of the company's financial performance and position for the reporting period. The specific direction or magnitude of the results remains unknown from the headline alone.

announcements.headline: Change of Broker
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a routine administrative change in the firm handling the company's investor relations or market-making activities. It generally indicates operational housekeeping rather than a material shift in strategy or financial performance.
